qualification.details: Office Superintendent: Bachelor's Degree with 05 years' experience in Administration & Establishment, Accounts or Purchase in Central/State Government, PSU, autonomous body or university/contractual /Private sector. Assistant Store officer: Diploma in Material Management with 03 years’ experience in store handling, preferably in medical stores. OR Graduate Degree with 02 years’ experience in store handling, preferably in medical stores. OR Post-Graduate Degree with 01 years’ experience in store handling, preferably in medical stores. Computer Programmer/IT Analyst: Bachelor’s Degree (B.Tech/B.E) in Computer Science, Information Systems, ECE, EEE, EE or equivalent with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA with minimum 02 years’ experience of working in software development, programming languages such as Java, C++, Python, etc. Desktop/IT Support Engineer: Graduate in BCA, B.Tech/B.E in IT/Computer Science/ Electronics Engineering with minimum 01 year’ experience in relevant field of desktop support/ IT technical support, troubleshooting computers, software, printers, network/user issues, etc. Receptionist: Passed Bachelor’s Degree in Mass Communication/Hospital Administration/ Hospitality Management from a Recognized University/Institute and ability to use computers Hands on experience in office applications, spread sheets and presentations. Personal Assistant: Passed in Bachelor’s Degree from a recognized University/Institution and Stenography: candidates are required to have English/Hindi shorthand and computer transcription skills. Multi-Tasking staff: Passed Matriculation from a recognized Board/Institution. Data Entry Operator: 12th Pass from a recognized Board/Institution. Certificate/course in Computer Applications such as DOEACC/NIELIT or equivalent. Typing Speed: Minimum typing speed of 35 words per minute (WPM) in English on computer.

Assistant Store officer: Diploma in Material Management with 03 years’ experience in store handling, preferably in medical stores. OR Graduate Degree with 02 years’ experience in store handling, preferably in medical stores. OR Post-Graduate Degree with 01 years’ experience in store handling, preferably in medical stores. Computer Programmer/IT Analyst: Bachelor’s Degree (B.Tech/B.E) in Computer Science, Information Systems, ECE, EEE, EE or equivalent with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA with minimum 02 years’ experience of working in software development, programming languages such as Java, C++, Python, etc. Desktop/IT Support Engineer: Graduate in BCA, B.Tech/B.E in IT/Computer Science/ Electronics Engineering with minimum 01 year’ experience in relevant field of desktop support/ IT technical support, troubleshooting computers, software, printers, network/user issues, etc. Receptionist: Passed Bachelor’s Degree in Mass Communication/Hospital Administration/ Hospitality Management from a Recognized University/Institute and ability to use computers Hands on experience in office applications, spread sheets and presentations. Personal Assistant: Passed in Bachelor’s Degree from a recognized University/Institution and Stenography: candidates are required to have English/Hindi shorthand and computer transcription skills. Multi-Tasking staff: Passed Matriculation from a recognized Board/Institution. Data Entry Operator: 12th Pass from a recognized Board/Institution. Certificate/course in Computer Applications such as DOEACC/NIELIT or equivalent. Typing Speed: Minimum typing speed of 35 words per minute (WPM) in English on computer.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the BECIL Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 20-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of BECIL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Broadcast Engineering Consultants India Limited (BECIL) for deployment in AIIMS, Rewari, Haryana on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 16 vacancies available across various posts including Office Superintendent, Assistant Store Officer, Computer Programmer, and Data Entry Operator.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 20-10-2026. Candidates must complete their registration and payment before this date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BECIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit generally ranges from a minimum of 18 years to a maximum of 40 years depending on the specific post you are applying for.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for general candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for all other categories except SC/ST and PWD is Rs. 295/-, whereas SC/ST and PWD candidates are exempted with NIL fee.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the BECIL posts?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online by visiting the official registration portal at https://becilregistration.in, filling out personal and educational details, and paying the fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for Office Superintendent?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University/Institute with 05 years of experience in Administration, Establishment, Accounts, or Purchase.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Data Entry Operator post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 26,208/-.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any offline mode of application available?
faq.answer: No, the application mode is strictly online through the official portal provided by BECIL. Offline applications will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes scrutiny and shortlisting of applications based on eligibility, followed by an interview, assessment, skill test, or other evaluation methods.
